mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reviews WHERE animation_id = #{animationId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT r.review_id, CASE WHEN r.is_hidden = 1 THEN '신고 누적으로 블라인드 처리된 리뷰입니다.' ELSE r.content END as content, r.rating, r.created_at, a.animation_id, a.title AS animationTitle, a.image_path AS animationImagePath FROM reviews r JOIN animations a ON r.animation_id = a.animation_id WHERE r.deleted_at IS NULL AND r.is_hidden = 0 ORDER BY r.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
